item.title: Water Cycle With Exact Labels

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen water-cycle explainer with a friendly voice-over you write. Show water rising, clouds forming, then rain. Label those stages exactly “Evaporation”, “Condensation”, and “Precipitation”, in that order. No other on-screen text.

item.tests: Tests exact rendered labels, correct stage mapping, and coordinated original narration in a short explainer.

answer_sheet.Exact on-screen labels: Evaporation; Condensation; Precipitation. Use that capitalization and order, without quotation marks.
answer_sheet.Other text: No other on-screen text, including subtitles.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: Friendly English voice; specific voice is your call.

must_haves: One approximately 10-second widescreen video has a friendly, intelligible English voice-over explaining the depicted cycle.
Water rises as vapor, clouds form, and rain falls, in that order.
The visible labels read exactly 'Evaporation', 'Condensation', and 'Precipitation', with no misspellings.
Each label is legible and appears with its corresponding stage, in the requested order.

**Nothing has been generated, and no credits have been spent.** I’ve only run free planning checks.

For a **10-second, 16:9, 480p** explainer using free-plan-compatible tools, the current estimate is:

| Part | Credits |
|---|---:|
| Three animated stages, 10 seconds total | 240 |
| Separately generated friendly narration¹ | 264 |
| Joining clips | 0 |
| **Total before resolving exact labels** | **504** |

¹The narration tool budgets an 11-second source recording for the 10-second edit.

**Proposed voice-over:**
> “Sunlight warms water, and it rises. It cools and forms clouds. Then rain falls, starting the cycle again.”

### Cheaper options
- **Shorter:** A 6-second version reduces animation costs from **240 to 144 credits**. Narration would need a shorter script and a fresh quote.
- **Silent:** Dropping the voice-over saves **264 credits**, but changes your request.
- **Separate label cards:** These guarantee exact spelling and cost no generation credits. Replacing some animation with cards lowers the preliminary total to **360 credits**, but the planner flagged narration-timing problems—so that version needs revision before it is ready.
- **Smaller:** **480p is the lowest supported resolution for this workflow**; I don’t have a cheaper lower-resolution option here.

**Important:** Model-generated labels can be misspelled. To meet your exact-text requirement reliably, I recommend separate cards reading only **“Evaporation”**, **“Condensation”**, and **“Precipitation”**, in that order.

Would you prefer **10 seconds with exact label cards**, or a **cheaper 6-second version**? I’ll give you the revised total for approval before generating anything.
